# 2. Writing to DB
## db_write()

```{r}
#| label: db_write

source(here("R/db_write.R"))

```

## Writing Season

```{r}
#| label: writing_season

season_result <- tryCatch(
  db_write(
    con = con, 
    table_name = "season_standings", 
    data = clean_season, 
    key_cols = c("season_id", "manager_id", "gameweek_id")
  ),
  error = function(e) list(error = paste("FAILED:", e$message))
)

```

## Writing Teams

```{r}
#| label: writing_teams

teams_result <- tryCatch(
  db_write(
    con = con, 
    table_name = "squads", 
    data = clean_teams, 
    key_cols = c("season_id", "manager_id", "gameweek_id", "player_slot")
  ),
  error = function(e) list(error = paste("FAILED:", e$message))
)

```

## Writing Transfers

```{r}
#| label: writing_transfers

transfers_result <- tryCatch(
  db_write(
    con = con, 
    table_name = "transfers", 
    data = clean_transfers, 
    key_cols = c("season_id", "manager_id", "gameweek_id", "player_out")
  ),
  error = function(e) list(error = paste("FAILED:", e$message))
)

```

## Confirmation

```{r}
#| label: all_tbls_written

write_results <- list(
  season_standings  = season_result,
  squads            = teams_result,
  transfers         = transfers_result
)

failed <- keep(write_results, \(x) !is.null(x$error))

if (length(failed) > 0) {
  stop("Database write failed for: ", paste(names(failed), collapse = ", "))
}

for (name in names(write_results)) {
  cat(glue("✓ {name}: {write_results[[name]]$inserted} rows added, {write_results[[name]]$updated} rows updated\n\n"))
}

```

## 3.2 Saving to .rds

```{r}
#| label: season_data

season_data <- list(
  gameweek_summary = gameweek_summary,
  gameweeks = gameweeks,
  manager_of_the_month = manager_of_the_month,
  manager_summary = manager_summary,
  managers = managers,
  player_captaincy = player_captaincy,
  player_summary = player_summary,
  seasons = seasons,
  squads = squads,
  standings = standings,
  team_names = team_names,
  transfers = transfers
)

dir <- here("data/report_data/season/")

if (!dir.exists(dir)) {
  
  dir.create(dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

saveRDS(season_data, file.path(dir, paste0(current_season, ".rds")))

```

# 4. Season Reports

```{r}
#| label: 03_report

current_season_managers <- standings |> 
  distinct(manager_id) |> 
  pull(manager_id)

for (mgr in current_season_managers) {
  
  output_file <- glue("report_{current_season}_{mgr}")
  output_dir <- here("outputs", current_season)
  
  if(!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
    dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  }
  
  quarto::quarto_render(
    input       = here("pipeline", "03_report.qmd"),
    output_file = output_file,
    execute_params = list(
      manager_id = mgr,
      season_id  = current_season
    )
  )
  
  file.rename(
    from = here("Pipeline", output_file),
    to   = here(output_dir, output_file)
  )
  
}
```
